Manage high-volume employee interactions across voice, email, chat and digital channels . Drive high First Contact Resolution (FCR) and minimize unnecessary escalations to Tier 2. Monitor service levels, queue performance, response times, contact volumes and operational capacity. Lead workforce planning, forecasting, scheduling and resource optimization to meet employee demand. Drive productivity, schedule adherence and efficient utilization of the team. Establish and maintain strong quality assurance and service standards , including regular monitoring, coaching and calibration. Ensure advisors consistently follow SOPs, scripts, policies and knowledge articles. Promote effective use of knowledge management tools and drive employee self-service adoption. Monitor and improve employee experience through CSAT, NPS, CES and other service metrics . Manage employee complaints, escalations and service recovery activities. Drive adoption of self-service tools, automation, virtual / AI agents and digital solutions to improve service delivery. Identify opportunities to reduce contact volumes through automation, knowledge enhancement and process improvements. Partner with HR Operations, HR Technology and other People Services teams to continuously improve the employee experience. Lead, coach and develop a team of People / Contact Centre Advisors. Drive performance management, engagement, capability building and service excellence across the team. Ideal Profile 6–8+ years of experience in HR Operations, People Services, Contact Centre, Customer Experience or a related service delivery environment. Proven experience leading high-volume contact centre or shared services operations . Previous experience within a Shared Services Center / Global Business Services / HR Operations environment is highly preferred. Strong experience managing frontline teams and service delivery operations. Strong understanding of contact centre KPIs , including FCR, AHT, SLA, CSAT, NPS, abandonment rate and productivity. Experience with workforce management, forecasting, scheduling and capacity planning. Strong customer / employee experience mindset with a focus on service quality. Experience driving process improvement, automation and digital / AI adoption is highly preferred. Strong knowledge of case management, knowledge management and HR service delivery platforms. Experience with SAP SuccessFactors or other HRIS platforms is an advantage. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making capabilities. Proven ability to coach, develop and motivate frontline teams. Location Cairo, Egypt Confidentiality: Due to the confidential nature of the search, further details about the organization and its People Services / Shared Services Center structure will be shared with shortlisted candidates.

review_candidates.description: 📝 AI Engineering Intern (Unpaid) ⚠️ Applications will only be accepted through the following site: 👉 www.owlera.site About Owlera Owlera is an AI-powered career platform that helps students and fresh graduates gain practical experience through internship simulations inspired by real companies. Participants work on realistic business challenges, receive AI-powered feedback, use modern professional tools, and build portfolio-ready projects that demonstrate their abilities to future employers. We're looking for curious, technically minded, and ambitious students to join our AI Engineering Internship and gain hands-on experience building practical AI applications — from prompt engineering and LLM integrations to RAG pipelines and AI agents. About the Internship As an AI Engineering Intern, you'll work on realistic engineering challenges involving prompt design, LLM-powered features, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, and AI agent workflows. You'll learn how AI engineers take business problems and turn them into working AI products — integrating models into applications, evaluating outputs, and iterating on real use cases. Responsibilities * Design and test prompts for real-world LLM use cases. * Build prototype features powered by large language models. * Integrate LLM APIs into simple web applications. * Build and experiment with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines. * Work with embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search. * Create AI agents that can reason, use tools, and complete multi-step tasks. * Evaluate AI outputs for accuracy, safety, and usefulness. * Debug and iterate on AI-powered features based on feedback. * Build conversational AI experiences such as chatbots and assistants. * Fine-tune simple models or use few-shot learning for specific tasks. * Process and prepare data for AI workflows (chunking, cleaning, formatting). * Connect AI features to databases and external APIs. * Write clean, readable code for AI experiments and prototypes. * Document AI experiments, prompts, and evaluation results. * Use modern developer tools (Git, notebooks, cloud platforms). * Learn the fundamentals of ML and deep learning concepts. * Collaborate with other interns on cross-functional AI projects. * Turn ambiguous product ideas into structured AI prototypes. Requirements * Current student or recent graduate in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or a strong self-taught coding portfolio. * Strong interest in artificial intelligence, LLMs, and machine learning. * Basic programming skills (Python is a plus; willingness to learn fast is essential). * Curiosity about how AI systems work under the hood. * Analytical and logical thinking with close attention to detail. * Self-motivated and able to work independently on technical challenges. * Comfortable experimenting, failing fast, and iterating. * Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms is a plus. * Previous professional AI engineering experience is not required. What You'll Gain * Hands-on experience building real AI applications, not just theory. * Practical experience with prompt engineering and LLM integrations. * Experience building RAG pipelines and semantic search. * Experience working with AI agents and multi-step AI workflows. * Understanding of how AI features are evaluated and improved. * Practical exposure to Python, APIs, and developer workflows. * Portfolio-ready AI projects built on realistic use cases. * Personalized AI feedback on your work. * Professional certificate upon successful completion. * Mentorship and weekly learning sessions. * Opportunity to strengthen your portfolio, resume, and interview readiness. Internship Details Role: AI Engineering Intern Location: Remote Type: Internship (Unpaid) Level: Entry Level Duration: 6 Weeks Commitment: Flexible (approximately 10–15 hours per week) If you're passionate about AI and want to learn how real AI products are built, we'd love to hear from you. ⚠️ Apply through: 👉 www.owlera.site

review_candidates.description: Why Join Us? Joining our team at UX Labs is like becoming part of a welcoming family that's dedicated to making a positive impact on the world. We thrive on creating delightful and user-friendly digital experiences through our products and services, and we do it with a strong sense of camaraderie. Here, you're not just an employee; you're a cherished member of a team that's deeply passionate about UX. We're all about crafting user-centered solutions, and we embrace flexibility, trust, and a vibrant sense of community. Your professional growth matters to us, and we'll provide the support and resources you need to succeed in the world of User Experience. So, joining us isn't just about a job; it's about being part of an environment where we take User Experience (UX) seriously. We don't just talk the talk; we walk the walk, applying UX principles effectively to solve real-world problems. You'll find a nurturing ground for your professional growth and a warm, welcoming community here. As a Mid-Level UX Researcher, you'll be the moderator of a harmony, working hand in hand with teams inside and outside our organization on a mix of exciting projects. Your role as a Mid-Level UX Researcher is not just about leading and pitching in on research, but it's all about sharing golden nuggets of wisdom that set our digital experiences on the right track. You'll be joining the band, collaborating with our UX Labs team and clients, to groove to the rhythm of user behaviors and preferences, and together, we'll create the perfect melody to help them hit their goals. Key Responsibilities Assist in Leading comprehensive user research, utilizing various methods such as usability testing, interviews, surveys, and analytics to gain deep insights into user behaviors and preferences. Assist in Leading UX Audit process under the guidance of more experienced team members or senior researchers. Plan, execute, and manage complex research studies, including participant recruitment, data collection, and in-depth analysis. Synthesize research findings into compelling, data-driven narratives and present insights to stakeholders at all levels of the organization. Develop and maintain user personas, customer journey maps, and other user-centered artifacts to inform design and development decisions. Articulate UX design insights and make cohesive design decisions. Design and Present findings and insights to internal stakeholders, making data-driven recommendations for improving user experiences. Collaborate with designers, product managers, and developers to translate research findings into actionable design recommendations. Guide junior members of the UX research team. Stay at the forefront of UX research trends and best practices, integrating the latest methodologies and tools into the research process. Qualifications Must have: Proven experience as a UX Researcher, with a strong work history showcasing your research work. Have an extended experience of: Usability Testing, User Interview, Expert Review, Personas, User Journey, and Stakeholders/ Discovery Interviews. Extended experience with various UX research tools and software, such as usability testing software, survey platforms, and analytics tools. Strong analytical and critical thinking skills. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and drive change within the organization. Strong project management skills and experience leading research initiatives. Leadership potential and the ability to mentor and guide junior team members. Nice to have: Acquired or successfully passed Related UX Courses, Certificates. Bachelor's or Master's degree in a related field (e.g., Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Anthropology, or a similar discipline) or an equivalent years or expertise in the field.
